document.title: Tighten the review layout
document.summary: The brief stacks each field name above its text and caps Why, What, and Look for near 68 characters. A source leads with its gist. The header drops the hunk count. A skipped binary is an info card. Hunk blocks are rounded. A click on the header gap collapses the file.
document.why: [This session](source:s1) asks to apply the approved audit to the fixed review UI.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 26
sources.gist: Apply the approved audit, then correct the header, the sources, the field headings, and the hunk click.

sources.label: cursor[bot] on PR #120
sources.author: cursor[bot]
sources.body: The file-path control now grows with flex-1 to fill the header row, so clicks on the empty space between the path and the hunk stats hit that button and open the file. The header still treats those clicks as collapse, and toggleCollapsed ignores anything inside a button, so the usual header click no longer collapses the file.

parts.name: Review layout
parts.summary: The fixed review UI caps the brief, stacks the field names, and gives the diff the width the file rail was using.

groups.title: Brief, sources, and the file count
groups.why: [This session](source:s1) asks to cap the brief, name each source, and show one file total. A skipped binary is named on the overview.
groups.summary: Why, What, and Look for stay near 68 characters, and each field name sits above that text. A source shows its gist first. The kind and the name sit under the gist. The header and the overview kicker share one file count. A skipped binary is an info card on the kicker.

groups.title: File rail and hunk rows
groups.why: [This session](source:s1) asks to drop the rail for one file and keep hunks as rounded blocks. [The review comment](source:s2) says a click on the header gap must collapse the file.
groups.summary: A group with one file renders the hunk alone. A multi-file group keeps a narrower rail. Hunk blocks are rounded and have a border, with no shadow. The path control stays as wide as the path, so a click on the header gap collapses the file.
lookFor: Subtle. Under 1099px the rail starts collapsed only when storage has no choice. A stored open value, or ?rail=open, keeps the rail open.
Subtle. The path button does not grow across the header. A click on the path opens the file. A click on the empty gap collapses it.

commits.subject: Keep the hunk path button on the path text.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The header click collapses the file again. The path control no longer grows into the gap, so that click does not open the file.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Put brief field names above their text.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Why, What, Look for, and Sources are headings over the paragraph, not a side column.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Lead each source with its text, and put the kind and name under it.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The gist uses the brief width. The kind icon, the kind, and the name sit on one quieter line, so the row no longer splits the text into a narrow column.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Hide skipped binaries behind an info card on the overview kicker.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The card says Skipped and names the path. It stays closed until the info icon is hovered, and it is absent when nothing was skipped.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Drop the hunk count, give sources the brief width, and round hunk blocks.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The header no longer reports grouped hunks. A skipped binary is a grey line on the overview, and only when a file was skipped. The 68-character measure stays on Why, What, and Look for. Hunk blocks are rounded again, with a border and no shadow.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Tighten review layout around the brief, the file rail, and hunk rows.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Cap brief prose, drop the rail for a single file, flatten hunk cards, and show one file total with skipped binaries named beside it.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
